gate_1_clean_walk.claim: every solve primitive a registered node kind's step traces sits inside a registered mime-solve scope, and the registry and the walk agree both ways on which node kind reaches which site

gate_1_clean_walk.metric: the count of solve primitives outside a registered scope, and the set difference of the sites reached and the sites claimed per node kind

control.resolution: one solve primitive anywhere in a step

gate_1_clean_walk.if_wrong: an unnamed solve in a registered node kind's step: register it or move it to a shared function, and report which
gate_1_clean_walk.cannot_discriminate_if: a step traces no solve primitive at all (the case would show nothing): the agreement test requires every claimed site to be reached

gate_2_float64_walk.metric: the dtypes of the operands and results of every equation inside a scope

gate_2_float64_walk.if_wrong: a float32 value inside a solve in a float64 run is a silent downcast: name it and fix it or declare it
gate_2_float64_walk.cannot_discriminate_if: a float32 run (x64 off): the walk is float64 only
